problem_solution.solution: A reminder-dispatch capability that selects due items, enqueues a reminder per item, and marks each dispatched within the same run so it is not re-selected.
known_pitfalls: due items missed at window boundaries
success_signals: each due item reminded once per due window
overlapping runs do not double-remind

blackbox.does: Evaluates tracked records against SLA targets on a schedule and flags approaching and breached deadlines, recording each flag once per record and threshold.

problem_solution.problem: SLA timers on tracked records need periodic evaluation against targets, and a watch that re-flags the same breach on every run drowns responders in noise.
problem_solution.naive_agent_failure: An agent flags every breached record on each scan with no state, so the same breach is raised repeatedly and real escalations are lost in the noise.
problem_solution.solution: A breach-watch capability that evaluates records against SLA targets and records each approaching or breached flag once per record and threshold.
known_pitfalls: re-flagging the same breach every run
success_signals: each threshold crossing flagged once
resolved records stop being flagged

blackbox.does: Applies a stage transition on a tracked record only if it is allowed from the current stage under guard conditions, recording the transition with its trigger.

problem_solution.problem: Trackers share a need to move records between stages under rules, and scattering ad hoc status writes lets records reach impossible or skipped states.
problem_solution.naive_agent_failure: An agent sets the stage field directly wherever convenient, bypassing the allowed-transition map so records land in states no path should reach.
problem_solution.solution: A stage-transition capability that checks the current stage and guard conditions against a declared transition map before applying and recording the move.
known_pitfalls: reaching states with no valid inbound path
guard conditions not evaluated before the move
re-applying a transition producing a duplicate event
success_signals: only declared transitions are applied
re-applying the same transition is a no-op

blackbox.does: Aggregates tracked records within a scope into a periodic status summary keyed by the period, so counts by stage and age are stable and recomputable.

problem_solution.problem: Dashboards need periodic counts of tracked records by stage and age, and recomputing them ad hoc yields inconsistent numbers that shift between reads.
problem_solution.naive_agent_failure: An agent recomputes rollups on every request without a fixed period key, so two reads of the same period return different numbers.
problem_solution.solution: A rollup capability that aggregates records within a scope into a period-keyed summary and writes it idempotently so a period recomputes to the same result.
known_pitfalls: period boundaries misaligned with the timezone
late-arriving records not reflected in a closed period
success_signals: re-running a period yields the same rollup
counts reconcile with the underlying records

blackbox.does: Transitions a subscription across trial, active, past-due, and canceled states, recording plan and period changes and appending the billing-relevant lifecycle event.

problem_solution.problem: Subscription state drives billing, so an inconsistent transition between trial, active, past-due, and canceled can bill the wrong amount or cut off access wrongly.
problem_solution.naive_agent_failure: An agent sets a subscription to canceled without recording the effective period, so proration and access-until dates are lost.
problem_solution.solution: A subscription-tracker capability that validates the lifecycle transition, records plan and period, and appends the billing-relevant event.
known_pitfalls: active and past-due states inconsistent with billing
success_signals: transitions follow the allowed lifecycle
duplicate lifecycle signals collapse to one event

blackbox.does: Updates a support ticket's status, assignee, and priority, appending the change to the ticket's activity trail and recording timestamps that later SLA checks rely on.

problem_solution.problem: Support tickets change status, assignee, and priority frequently, and losing the ordered trail of those changes makes SLA and handoff review impossible.
problem_solution.naive_agent_failure: An agent flips ticket status without recording the transition timestamp, so first-response and resolution SLAs cannot be computed.
problem_solution.solution: A ticket-tracker capability that applies status, assignee, and priority changes, stamps transition times, and appends each change to the activity trail.
known_pitfalls: missing transition timestamps for SLA math
reopen not distinguished from new resolution
success_signals: every transition timestamped in the trail
SLA-relevant times recoverable from history

blackbox.does: Updates a vendor's status, contacts, and qualification across the procurement lifecycle, appending the change so onboarding and approval state remain auditable.

problem_solution.problem: Vendor records move through onboarding, qualification, and approval, and losing the trail of who approved a vendor undermines procurement controls.
problem_solution.naive_agent_failure: An agent flips a vendor to approved without recording the approver or qualification basis, breaking the procurement audit trail.
problem_solution.solution: A vendor-tracker capability that validates the qualification transition, updates contacts and status, and appends the change with its approver.
known_pitfalls: duplicate vendor records for one entity
success_signals: each qualification change carries an approver
vendor state transitions stay within the lifecycle
